text: Figure 11.22: Scenario: Critical Supervision Failure in Execution Management The figure 11.22 shows an alternate scenario for Report Supervision Failure that handles a critical supervision failure in Execution Management . Such failures are considered as critical failures because Execution Management is required to recover from supervision failures. Thus, a supervision failure in Execution Management results in Platform Health Management calling the method FireWatchdogReaction() to perform a restart of the Machine.
